description: This PHP source file defines the CampaignsViewModulelistmenu class, which extends the ViewModulelistmenu class to customize display behavior for the campaign module list menu. The class's display method retrieves recently viewed campaign-related items and assigns them to the view for rendering.

classes.name: CampaignsViewModulelistmenu
classes.description: A view class that extends ViewModulelistmenu to customize the rendering of the module list menu for campaigns, including fetching recent views and assigning data for display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Fetches recently viewed items related to campaigns, processes item summaries and images, and assigns this data to the Smarty template for rendering the module list menu.
